message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read directly from stdin with no remote fetching, so no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check for a remote source is present or needed.

No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions for anomalies, or uses a label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline applies normalization and balancing but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: Although a `load_model_sav` function is imported, there is no visible hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before or after loading any serialized model in the visible code paths.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs balancing (finds_best_data_set_balance, balancing_training_dataset) but does not explicitly validate label distribution or check for expected label sets before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train/test splits are used, there is no isolation enforcement (e.g., signed/hashed evaluation data or a truly held-out set never touched during preprocessing/balancing), and balancing is applied after splitting which can leak information; no independent metric signing or verification is pre

No detected input sanitization: The only validation is a source whitelist check ('PD'/'CT') in report(); there are no shape checks, range/type validation, or schema enforcement on the incoming dataframe or its columns.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions and AUC scores are printed and returned directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML classifiers (NB, KNN, DT, RF, XGBoost), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
